cc:Work.dc:title: Regional carbon-price indices
cc:Work.dc:description: 9 disjoint groups cover all 28 model regions. Each line is an index calculated as the weighted mean of model-region carbon prices, using fixed 2019 industrial greenhouse-gas emissions as weights. The weights do not change with decarbonisation or relocation of industry, so changes reflect the price paths. These indices are not uniform regional policies, population-weighted prices, or averages across countries. North America includes the United States, Canada and Mexico; Europe contains the five European model regions; China is the CHN model region. Exact membership and numerical weights are supplied in CSV files.
